thread:
dara: Quick experiment idea  run two microcopy treatments on the pricing estimator: Developer-first vs Business-first. Want to see which reduces hesitation and increases trial starts.

mike: good split. what exactly changes between treatments?

dara: Developer-first focuses on tokens/examples: short technical hint and an example payload. Button: "Estimate for my app". Business-first focuses on outcome: monthly bill + ROI blurb. Button: "See pricing for my team".

nina: we should also test FAQ placement: inline small FAQ under widget vs a link to full FAQ modal. might change trust signals.

sam: frontend: trivial A/B flag. events: pricing_copy_variant, pricing_faq_variant, estimator_submitted. ETA 2 dev days + tracking.

leigh: routing: any lead that checks "Contact me" goes to sales. For high ARR estimates (>= 60k) route to enterprise SDR. include field: copy_variant.

mike: experiment metrics: widget impression -> submit rate, submit -> trial start, and reduction in "how much will it cost" support tickets. Also record time-on-widget as proxy for confusion.

nina: localization note: business-first copy must avoid currency idioms for EU test. Legal: include short privacy line when storing estimate.

marketing-bot: Reminder: Align with Webinar "Benchmarks that matter" on 2026-06-01. If we have a clear winner, include it in the post-webinar follow-up.

dara: timeline: confirm copy variants by EOD, eng ticket tomorrow, QA next Tue, rollout to 50% EU traffic after QA. run 14 days.

sam: I'll add the analytics spec and open the PR.

leigh: Sales ops will provide CRM mapping and sample payload by tomorrow.

mike: I'll draft both copy variants and a very short FAQ microcopy. Posting drafts in 2 hours.

dara: thanks all. checklist: copy approved, legal snippet, events wired, CRM mapping, translations. ping here when done. :white_check_mark:
